name: Geneen Roth
reason: Health restore (new rule, 12 Nov 2026): re-checked geneenroth.com. Her home page now frames the work more broadly ('the stories we live by'), but every paid offering is still eating- and weight-led: the January 2027 live online retreat promises to 'heal your relationship with food' and 'break free from the endless cycle of diets'; the Women Food and God online courses are sold on ending emotional eating; the Ending Obsession workshop ($99) teaches eating guidelines described as 'a proven, direct way to lose weight' and achieving 'natural weight'. Diet and weight-loss programmes are always out, so nothing paid passes, and most of her books are food-centred. Skipped. She publishes info@geneenroth.com; the owner could revisit if a books-only listing (e.g. Lost and Found, This Messy Magnificent Life) were wanted.
